# Heading

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders heading text and registers it for navigation and table-of-contents generation.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `TextBlock`. Implements `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Heading(text?: string)
new Heading(options: HeadingOptions)
new Heading(text: string, options?: HeadingOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`anchorId`](#anchorid): Optional named-anchor id.
- [`keepWithNext`](#keepwithnext): Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.
- [`level`](#level): Heading level (1–6).
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): PDF/UA structure role for this element.
- [`tocIdentifier`](#tocidentifier): Gets or sets the unique identifier used to look up this heading in the TOC entries dictionary.

### `anchorId`

```typescript
anchorId?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional named-anchor id. When set, this heading doubles as a cross-reference target: it records its page number against `anchorId` in the shared TOC registry so a [`SectionLink`](section-link.md) can jump to it and a [`PageNumberOf`](page-number-of.md) can print its page. Independent of `tocIdentifier` (which drives the on-page [`VisualToc`](visual-toc.md)); a heading may carry either, both, or neither.

Example, from `industry-templates/compliance-audit/compliance-findings-register`:

```typescript
heading.anchorId = 'priority-actions';
```

Example, from `industry-templates/compliance-audit/compliance-findings-register`:

```typescript
heading.anchorId = anchorFor(finding.id);
```

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext: boolean
```

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `level`

```typescript
level: number
```

Heading level (1–6). Maps to PDF/UA structure roles `H1`…`H6` when the document opts into tagging via `DocumentSettings.accessibility`. Default `1`. Values outside 1–6 are clamped.

Example, from `code-recipes/page-setup/margins`:

```typescript
h.level = 2;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/tables-lists/lists`:

```typescript
h.level = 1;
```

### `semanticRole`

```typescript
readonly semanticRole: SemanticRole
```

*read-only*

PDF/UA structure role for this element. Defaults to [`SemanticRole.P`](semantic-role.md#p) (a paragraph). [`Heading`](heading.md) overrides this to return one of H1…H6.

### `tocIdentifier`

```typescript
tocIdentifier: string
```

Gets or sets the unique identifier used to look up this heading in the TOC entries dictionary. Must match the identifier passed to VisualToc.HeadingIdentifiers.

Example, from `industry-templates/billing-payments/utility-bill`:

```typescript
h.tocIdentifier = id;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/page-setup/margins`:

```typescript
h.tocIdentifier = text;
```

## Methods

- [`renderStateful`](#renderstateful): Renders this heading in a stateful manner, registering the TOC entry on first render and delegating text rendering to the base TextBlock implementation.
- [`resetState`](#resetstate): Resets the render state so the heading can be re-rendered on subsequent layout passes (e.g. during two-pass TOC resolution).
